# PX98 Lubricants

> PX98 is a premium automotive lubricant brand developed by PRINCE GLOBAL PTE. LTD.,
> a Singapore manufacturer. The range covers passenger car engine oils, commercial
> diesel engine oils, automatic transmission fluids, gear oils, coolants and vehicle
> service fluids, formulated against API, ILSAC, ACEA and OEM performance levels.

Brand: PX98. Manufacturer: PRINCE GLOBAL PTE. LTD., Singapore. Established 1998.
Sold through appointed distributors rather than direct. No prices are published.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.px98lubricants.com/): the brand, the range and the viscosity coverage
- [Products](https://www.px98lubricants.com/products.html): all 37 products, filterable by category, grade and approval
- [Technology](https://www.px98lubricants.com/technology.html): base stocks, additive systems and the performance that follows
- [About](https://www.px98lubricants.com/about.html): PRINCE GLOBAL PTE. LTD., quality assurance and sustainability
- [FAQ](https://www.px98lubricants.com/faq.html): viscosity grades, API and ILSAC categories, Low SAPS, LSPI, ATF against CVT and DCT, DOT 4 against DOT 5.1
- [Distributors](https://www.px98lubricants.com/distributors.html): exclusive territory appointments and the enquiry form
- [Contact](https://www.px98lubricants.com/contact.html): product, technical and distribution enquiries

### Brake Fluid

- [PX98 MODERN DOT 5.1 BRAKE FLUID](https://www.px98lubricants.com/product-modern-dot-5-1-brake-fluid.html): Synthetic Borate Ester Formula. FMVSS No.116 DOT 5.1, SAE J1704, ISO 4925 Class 5.1/6, JIS K2233. For Modern Hydraulic Brake & Clutch Systems Requiring DOT 3, DOT 4 or DOT 5.1 Brake Fluid (excluding silicone DOT 5 systems).
- [PX98 ENGINE CLEANING FLUSH](https://www.px98lubricants.com/product-engine-cleaning-flush.html): Rapid Cleaning Detergency Carrier Fluid. For Gasoline, Diesel, Turbocharged & Hybrid Engines.
- [PX98 ENGINE PERFORMANCE TREATMENT](https://www.px98lubricants.com/product-engine-performance-treatment.html): Advanced Friction Reduction Technology. For Gasoline, Diesel, Turbocharged & Hybrid Engines.
